page_title: LIL 1-1 TOU | Lille v Toulouse 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Mathieu Vernice has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+5' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mathieu Vernice no option but to blow his whistle.
90+3' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
90+2' Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse). Free kick. Lille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+1' It's a yellow card for Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Tiago Santos (Lille) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
88' Toulouse keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a throw-in.
85' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
85' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lille.
85' Remy Cabella (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
82' Off the post! Remy Cabella (Lille) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the left post.
82' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
79' An attempted cross from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is cleared. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aron Donnum.
77' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) replaces Cesar Gelabert Pina.
76' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Angel Gomes is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Ounas (Lille) is coming onto the pitch as Ivan Cavaleiro cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Guillaume Restes comes off his line to intercept the corner from Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
75' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
71' Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but Lucas Chevalier comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

65' 1 - 1 Goal! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Vincent Sierro, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot inside the left post. What a finish that is - 1:1!
64' Alexsandro (Lille) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
63' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul after Ismaily (Lille) hacks down one of his opponents.
63' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) replacing Cristian Casseres.
61' Booking. Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) receives a caution from the referee.
60' A pass into the box finds Edon Zhegrova (Lille) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Guillaume Restes denies him.
57' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
55' That's unlucky! Angel Gomes (Lille) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
54' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is able to continue to play.
50' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make a change. Leny Yoro is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Samuel Umtiti (Lille).
47' Leny Yoro (Lille) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
47' Jonathan David (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mathieu Vernice had an easy-decision to make.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Jonathan David (Lille) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
42' Tiago Santos (Lille) serves up a nice cross, but Guillaume Restes punches the ball away.
40' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' A lofted cross from Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Toulouse earn a corner.
39' The free kick is taken by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), but ball is cleared.
38' Tempers flare after Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
36' Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul after Logan Costa (Toulouse) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) swings in a cross from the corner, but Guillaume Restes reads it well and gathers the ball.
34' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Edon Zhegrova (Lille). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.
33' Angel Gomes (Lille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Lille win a corner.

30' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Edon Zhegrova crosses the ball in, Leny Yoro (Lille) peels away from his marker near the penalty spot and plants a header past Guillaume Restes and in off the left post. He displayed his eye for goal there with an excellent finish. 1:0.
29' The corner kick from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
29' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. Now Lille have a corner.
29' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.

28' Tiago Santos (Lille) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
27' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is adjudged offside.
24' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Leny Yoro (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' The linesman signals that Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
19' Leny Yoro (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

16' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball has crossed the sideline. Toulouse are taking a throw-in.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Angel Gomes (Lille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
9' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
5' Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
3' Ismaily (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lille will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will supervise the game today.
